Principal MBA, M.Phil., Ph.D., NET Dr L. Vijayashree is an accomplished academic leader, innovation strategist and entrepreneurship mentor with over nineteen years of academic experience, including three years as Head and Professor of MBA and four years in industry. She blends institutional leadership with a strong commitment to research, intellectual property creation, and start-up incubation. A certified Harvard Design Thinker, she has delivered numerous invited talks, mentored entrepreneurs, and secured multi-crore grants for student-led innovation projects across India. She is a regular columnist in daily newspapers, sharing insights on student development, particularly within business schools, and is known for advocating creative teaching methods such as role plays, games, street theatre, simulations, exercises and mind mapping to enhance engagement and learning outcomes. Her work is further enriched through collaborations with leading International and National bodies, including universities in Singapore and Taiwan, RIPO Belarus, the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India and the Department of Science and Technology, among several others. Achievements Former Head – Innovation & Entrepreneurship Development Cell at BNMIT and Chief Coordinator – New Gen IEDC, DST, Government of India (2017 – April 2025). Head - Innovation and Design Thinking Course (2021 – 2025). Oversaw the filing of 27 IRPs from New Gen IEDC Department, of which 18 were granted in a short span. Recipient of design patents for prototypes “Portable Wind Turbine”, “Solar Smart Bench”, “Solar Power Refrigerated Vending Cart”, “IoT-based Green Energy Charging Station”, “Smart Cradle for Baby Monitoring”, “Sensor-based Multifunctional Electric Wheelchair for Safety” and “Lightweight Electronically Controlled Mobile Ventilator”. Copyright holder for “Smart Yoga Instructor Device for Guiding and Correcting Yoga Postures”. National recognition: She was awarded “Dr. V. G. Patel Memorial Award 2024” as the 2nd Best Entrepreneurship Mentor at the National level.
